baseline_selection.auc: minimum geometric mean cumulative risk among resource-feasible baselines within each cell
baseline_selection.terminal: minimum geometric mean terminal risk among resource-feasible baselines within each cell

gates.S1: exact row counts, finite outputs, disjoint development and confirmation seeds
gates.S2: every policy uses exactly four environment transitions per launch
gates.S3: signed policy average messages do not exceed each budget plus 1/launches
gates.S4: active-cell median terminal-risk improvement is at least 0.10
gates.S5: signed policy strictly improves terminal risk in at least 0.80 of active cells and is not worse in any active cell
gates.S6: active-cell median cumulative-risk improvement is positive and strict improvement fraction is at least 0.80
gates.S7: median terminal improvement is positive in every registered nonzero coupling, delay, budget, and switch group
gates.S8: maximum absolute terminal and cumulative difference in uncoupled controls is at most 1e-12
gates.S9: minimum mean number of signed graph supports over active cells is at least 5
gates.S10: all 24 declared strong baselines are present and resource feasibility is checked before envelope selection
gates.S11: no scientific result or output path exists before the preregistration commit
gates.S12: isolated rerun is byte-identical for endpoints, cells, and core summary

stopping_rule: any failure of S1-S11 records an honest failure and forbids estimator integration under this identifier; S12 still reproduces the pass or failure without retuning
